requirements.text: Built production web applications using React
Wrote production application code in TypeScript
Designed and evolved APIs over time, using GraphQL or REST
Built and ran Node.js backend services in production
Worked with PostgreSQL and designed data models for an application
Delivered real-time data to the browser using WebSockets or a similar technology
Improved application performance with measurable results
Made architectural decisions and owned a major part of a product end to end
Worked on fintech products or trading systems
Worked with event-driven architectures and message queues
Mentored other engineers or acted as a tech lead for a team
